title: Fado
tagline: Portuguese song shaped by expressive voices and a distinctive guitar tradition.
summary: Fado is a Portuguese song tradition often associated with expressive vocals, themes of longing, and the bright, intricate sound of the Portuguese guitar. It developed in urban neighborhoods and has been performed in intimate settings as well as on international stages. Artists continue to reinterpret the tradition while preserving its distinctive phrasing and emotional depth.

pillars.name: Amália Rodrigues
pillars.why: Rodrigues became the best-known international ambassador for fado through an influential recording and performance career.

pillars.name: Carlos do Carmo
pillars.why: Do Carmo brought a modern sensibility to fado while remaining closely connected to its Lisbon tradition.

pillars.name: Carlos Paredes
pillars.why: Paredes was a celebrated Portuguese guitarist whose instrumental work expanded the expressive possibilities of the instrument.
